content: Soo Saul sutawununa yise ka umu Te Pabe'e Jesus naka'oedyukudu goewunu. Soo Saul mu Jew numu moohedu meeoo netamma ka Jerusalem-wi'yoona.

Ka Damascus mee naneadu-kwitoo mu Jew numu moohedu-matoo tupo, “Nuka tummatzi,” mee mu netamma. Umu Te Pabe'e Jesus naka'oedyukudu sakwa nakwutuma. O'no saa'a yise mu ka Jesus naka'oedyukudu Jerusalem-witoo bika.
Soo Saul tu pupua'amu-no meana oona Damascus tzage'e manegase, hemma tukwukwutseba-wa'nekoo poonnese yise anoaka.
Soo Te Pabe'e ka Saul meeoo netamma, “U suda a masoonammekute.”
“Haga u?” mee soo Saul unne. Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo, “Nu Jesus u yow ooosapa suda e masoonammennumme.
Yotsese mea'ase ka Damascus-wi petugase u u manekwuna natuukwedooa.”
Umu oo pupua'amu gi ha'yoo unni-kwa'ne'yoo ka oo naka pana gi haka poonnena.
Soo Saul yotsese, oonatu too'e poonne pana gi tubootabue mani. Umu oo pupuamu oo mi-makoo oo tzakaka ka Damascus mee naneadu-kwitoo.
Pahe tabeno maneka soo Saul ka gi tubootabue manese, gi tukana gi hemma hebena.

Sumu'yoo Te Pabe'e Jesus naka'oedyukudu Ananias mee naneadu Damascus-wi nobe-ga'yoo. Soo Te Pabe'e, “Ananias,” mee, uni mee tuusoobedyana. “Nu u naka,” mee soo Ananias oo nanekwegea. Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo, “Yotsese, meana ka Judas nobe-kwitoo ka Saul-witu tutubenga. Oona soo po kaaheno hape Judas ookow po-kumaba nobe-ga'yoo ka Saul
no u yadooakwu.
U, Ananias, ka Saul-ma matuguse oosoo besa tubootabue 'manekwu, mee soo Saul tuusoobedya.”
Soo Ananias meeoo unakwe, “Ewa'yoo numu ka Saul-witu e tuukwe. Soo Saul gi besa'yoo nana. Soo Saul ka Jerusalem-witu mu ume naka'oedyukudu wutumetana mu kutsedyina, mu wuko'e.
Soo Saul yow petu ooosoo manekwuse.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka Ananias nekwegea, “Unu mease, nu oo netutzea ka Saul no'obatusoo numu nu-kwitu tuukwekwu, mee nu unakwe. Mu wakwawa'a moohedu, yise oo Jew nananumu.
Ewa'yoosoo mu numu ka Saul nekwutumana, oo kutsedyana ka nu-kwitu pumme ka Saul tuukwe'e,” mee soo Ananias nose.

Soo Ananias yise ka Judas nobe-kwi petugase, ka Saul-ma matuguse, meeoo oo netamma, “E pua'a, soo Te Pabe'e Jesus u-baa petudu u-nosoo nummedu u-matoo e taya. Ume oosoo magwetzoise. Yise ka besa'hoo tu pooha-matu-ma u sootuhi.”
Hee sapaga ka Saul pooe-kwi'yoona sawehoose, oosoo besa tubootabue 'mani. Yotsese, yise soo Ananias baa-wi oo matzaka
saa'a ka tukase natzooesoo 'manepetuga.
Soo Saul ka mu Jew numu meeoo tuukwe soo Jesus Te Pabe'e mee'e, yise ka mu Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukudu-baa huu tooiyakwe ka Damascus-wi.

Ewa'yoo umu oo nakadu gi oo naka'oedyukuna mee unakwe, “Esoo nana mu Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukudu goepu ka Jerusalem-wi'yoona. Masoo yaatuoo mu Te Pabe'e Jesus naka'oedyukudu wutumetakwuse mu Jew numu moohedu yise Jerusalem-witoo mu bikakwu. Masoo meno'o meeoo te netamma oo naka'oedyuku soo Jesus Te Pabe'e.”
Soo Saul nenagu'a ka Te Naa unnena Te Naa Besa pooha-toohakwi oo wahana unusoo poohatoo'a. Ka mu Jew numu tubetse tzapoonnekute soo Jesus Te Pabe'e. Umu numu gi hanotosoo hayoo unne-wa'ne'yoo.

Ka saa'a mu Jew numu tunehane ka Saul patsakuse tabewano, togawano oona natzakwuna'a-wi oo too'e potamana. Soo Saul mu naka ka pumme mu batsakwuse. Mu susumudu Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukudu ka pabatsekoo kawona-wikoo ka tupe nagoodeadoona ka mu numu nogaduna na'oonnakwidu habedu oonow tawaga-too natzakweku tugapoo-ma ka togano.
Soo Saul ka Jerusalem-wi petugase mu Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukudu-no too'e nesumu'u. Umu sua'e ka gi tunaka'oedyukuna ka ookow puu Te Pabe'e Jesus oo naka'oedyukute.

Soo Barnabas oo naka'oedyukuna oo bikea oona mu tuukwewabe-matoo. Soo Barnabas mee unakwe, “Esoo nana ka oona Damascus po-wi'yoona ka Te Pabe'e poonnese oo nakabetsea. Ka Damascus-wi masoosoo mu numu-ma suina ka Te Pabe'e Jesus pooha-toohakwi Jesus-witu mu numu tuukwe.”
Soo Saul yise Jerusalem-wi mu tunaka'oedyukudu-no ka mu Jew numu-ma gi suina, mu nesumuse ka Te Pabe'e-witu mu tuukwe ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-toohakwi.
Ka mu Jew numu Greek-ma yadooadu-no nanepetukute. Unu umu oo nesutakute umu ka oo batsakwu mee sokwamana.
Mu Te Pabe'e-wi tunaka'oedyukudu o nakase oo bikea oona Caesarea mee naneadu-kwitoo oo nobe-kwitoosoo o kodyu tuunguna.

Ka Saul tunaka'oedyuku 'manese, mu tunaka'oedyukudu ka teepu Judea, Galilee, Samaria mee nananeadu-koobatu gi how nuugwe, gi nuutumetana, gi namatzama. Umu ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-ma nasootuhise Te Naa podo mea. Ewa yise 'manepetuga.
Ka saa'a soo Peter mu tunaka'oedyukudu oona kwaya'a-kwitu nobenedyinnumme. Oona ka Lydda mee naneadu-kwi petuga mu tunaka'oedyukudu nobengena.

Sumu'yoo nana Aeneas mee naneadu ka Lydda-wi nobe-ga'yoo, gi yutsungadu ooosapa habedabe namewatsu (8) tomokapu. Oo-baa soo Peter petugase meeoo oo netamma, “Soo Te Pabe'e Jesus u mabesakukwu. Yotsese, u kapa mabetsabe.”
Ewa'yoo mu numu Lydda-wi nonobe-ga'yoo, yise ewa'yoo numu Sharon mee naneadu tubewa-witu oo poonnese oo naka'oedyuku soo Jesus Te Pabe'e.
Sumu'yoo mogo'ne tunaka'oedyukudu Tunna mee naneadu oona Joppa mee naneadu-kwi nobe-ga'yoo. Ewa nanabesa tumadugupu. Ewow numu tutuha manedu gi hee-gakoo tummatza'e.
Soo Tunna yise unu tuoeyaese ya'e. Mu oo pupua'amu oo tookoo pakedyase oona nobe-kooba tuutse'e nanobe-too-kwi oo tzatugu.
Mu tunaka'oedyukudu oo sopedakwatoo ka Peter oona Lydda-wikoo soo Joppa ono natsage'e. Umu waha'yoo naana ka Peter ba'e, oo natummatzi tuunguna.

Soo Peter ka nobe-kwi petuoose oosoo ka tuutse oo-kooba nanobe-too-kwitoo meahoo. No'yoona mu momoko'ne gi kookoomama-ga'yoo sakwina manegonno, ka wanapu pukwi tu namasooana ka Peter tzapoonnekute ka gisoo Tunna ya'e oo tumadabuena.
Soo Peter yise no'oko puuwanatoo mu taya Te Naa-matoo meatzedose nanesootuhise ka Tunna tookoo yadoo'e, “Yotseoo Tunna.”
Soo Peter ka Tunna mi-makoo oo tzadyotase oo kuku-ma oo tzawunukuoo. Oo gwetzoina mu tunaka'oedyukudu tzapoonnekute, mu gi kookoomamu-gakoo nokosoo tuwazoo.
Mu Joppa-witu ewa'yoo oo naka ka namanena yise ka Te Pabe'e Jesus-wi tunaka'oedyukuhoo.
Sumu'yoo nana ka Joppa-witu Simon mee naneadu kootsoo puhu mahanedu. Soo Peter wuna'me ka Simon-baa.
